ip_top_stories.title: Delhi High Court Refuses Interim Injunction Against ChatGPT, Holds AI Training and Outputs Prima Facie Do Not Infringe Copyright – The Legal Affair
ip_top_stories.summary: The Delhi High Court has declined to grant an interim injunction against OpenAI in the ANI Media copyright case, ruling that AI training on copyrighted content and its outputs are prima facie protected under India's fair dealing doctrine. The court also found that restraining ChatGPT could be detrimental to the growth of AI and harm the public interest. The ruling is being described as India's first substantive judicial engagement with AI and copyright.

ip_top_stories.title: Anthropic agrees to $150mn copyright settlement over AI training
ip_top_stories.summary: Anthropic has agreed to a $150 million settlement to resolve copyright claims related to its use of copyrighted material in training its AI systems. The settlement is one of the largest of its kind in the AI copyright litigation landscape.

ip_top_stories.title: As GEMA awaits its Suno copyright verdict, the German collecting society launches 'PLAI' – a fully licensed dataset for training AI music tools
ip_top_stories.summary: German music collecting society GEMA has launched 'PLAI', a fully licensed dataset designed for training AI music generation tools, while it awaits a court verdict in its copyright case against AI music platform Suno. The move signals a parallel licensing-based approach to AI training alongside ongoing litigation.

ip_top_stories.title: Music Publishers Canada Files to Intervene in Landmark AI and Copyright Federal Court Case
ip_top_stories.summary: Music Publishers Canada has filed to intervene in a landmark Canadian federal court case concerning AI and copyright, signalling growing industry mobilisation around the legal boundaries of AI training on copyrighted musical works.

ip_top_stories.title: Harry Potter publisher secures major payout in historic AI copyright case
ip_top_stories.summary: The publisher of the Harry Potter series has secured a significant financial payout in what is being described as a historic AI copyright case. Further details on the defendant and settlement terms are reported in the article.

ip_further_links.title: Dog Photographer Loses Copyright Case Over AI-Generated Comic Version of Her Photo
ip_further_links.summary: A dog photographer has lost a copyright infringement case involving an AI-generated comic adaptation of her photograph, in a ruling that tests the boundaries of derivative works and AI-generated content.

ip_further_links.title: Is training AI on copyrighted materials protected by the First Amendment? - FIRE | Foundation for Individual Rights and Expression
ip_further_links.summary: FIRE examines whether using copyrighted materials to train AI systems could be protected under the First Amendment, adding a free speech dimension to the ongoing AI copyright debate.

ip_further_links.title: AI Raises New Questions About Fashion Design Ownership and Copyright
ip_further_links.summary: The use of AI in fashion design is prompting new legal questions about who owns AI-assisted designs and how existing copyright frameworks apply to them.

ip_further_links.title: Netflix uses AI in 300 titles, but human input still determines copyright.
ip_further_links.summary: Netflix has disclosed that AI has been used in the production of around 300 titles, while noting that the presence of human creative input remains the key factor in determining copyright eligibility.

ip_further_links.title: Can I Remix Madonna? Is This All Legal? An A.I. Music F.A.Q.
ip_further_links.summary: A practical FAQ addressing common questions about the legality of using AI to remix or reproduce music by established artists, covering copyright and fair use considerations.

ip_further_links.title: How to see who is eligible for Anthropic's AI copyright settlement
ip_further_links.summary: A guide explaining how affected rights holders can check their eligibility to claim from Anthropic's $150 million AI copyright settlement.

ip_further_links.title: [Guest Book Review] Creative Value Chains – Copyright and Beyond for a Better Value Distribution
ip_further_links.summary: IPKat publishes a guest review of a new academic work examining copyright frameworks and value distribution across creative industries, with relevance to AI-era publishing and rights management.

ip_further_links.title: South Korean startup seeks to bridge AI music copyright infrastructure gap
ip_further_links.summary: A South Korean startup is developing infrastructure to address the gap in music copyright licensing for AI training and generation, aiming to create compliant pathways for the AI music industry.
